title: Auth System Refactor
description: Modernize authentication by removing legacy sessions, rolling out JWT + refresh rotation, and safely migrating existing users with minimal downtime and strong security guarantees.

phases.title: Remove legacy session middleware
phases.description: Strip out the old cookie-based session store and all references to it across the codebase.

tasks.desc: Remove session imports from app.ts and api/router.ts
Update CHANGELOG and deprecation notice in README

phases.title: Implement JWT authentication
phases.description: Add stateless JWT-based auth with refresh token rotation and secure HttpOnly cookie delivery.

tasks.desc: Implement token signing and verification in src/auth/jwt.ts
Add refresh token rotation logic with Redis backing store
Write integration tests for login, refresh, and logout flows

phases.title: Migrate existing users
phases.description: Run a one-time migration script to invalidate all legacy sessions and force re-authentication.

tasks.desc: Test migration in staging against prod-size dataset
Schedule maintenance window and run migration in production
